title: Scale a rect
prompt: Return the rectangle with both its position and its size multiplied by factor, as if the whole drawing were zoomed from the top-left corner of the screen. The starter scales only the size.
starter:
func solve(r, factor) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(r.position, r.size * factor)
hints: The position needs the same treatment as the size.

docs.name: Rect2(x, y, width, height)
docs.what: Makes a rectangle from a top-left corner and a size. Also Rect2(position, size) with two vectors.

docs.name: r.position, r.size, r.end
docs.what: The top-left corner, the width and height, and the bottom-right corner, all Vector2.

docs.name: a + b, a - b, v * number, v / number
docs.what: Vectors add and subtract part by part, and scale by a plain number.

solution:
func solve(r, factor) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(r.position * factor, r.size * factor)
